identified_issues: PREEMPTION_GAP_WITH_UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION: Physical breaker actuation occurred without prior approved switching authorization required by Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2.
UNLAWFUL_RETROSPECTIVE_CURE: Submission of retrospective order SO-2026-8812 after physical switching violates the explicit non-retroactivity and authorization standard.
FADT_SUPPORT_BOUNDARY_VIOLATION: Maintenance trip initiated at the local relay interface lacked an admitted upstream conditioning dispatch ticket.
evidence: DISPATCH_EMS registry log at 2026-10-06T15:50:00.000Z confirms pre-authorization status: NONE and no switching order on file for BKR_512.
RELAY_SEL_451 fault recorder records manual front panel trip at 2026-10-06T16:10:02.100Z opening BKR_512 with line current dropping to 0.0 A prior to any approved switching order.
DISPATCH_EMS log entry EMS_LOG_9941 at 2026-10-06T16:12:15.000Z confirms retrospective ticket SO-2026-8812 was generated post-switching with status RETROSPECTIVE_UNAUTHORIZED.

Regional Grid Operating Standard Section 4.2 explicitly stipulates that physical maintenance switching without an approved prior Switching Order constitutes an unauthorized line disconnection that cannot be cured retrospectively.
recommended_action: Sustain the compliance auditor's finding of FAIL. Initiate formal unauthorized switching remediation, enforce interlock controls preventing relay manual trip during maintenance without validated dispatch ticket pre-authorization, and prohibit retrospective authorization laundering in dispatch records.
